lines.zh: 从这朵花飞到下一朵，花粉沾满腿。
lines.en: Flower to flower, pollen packed thick on both legs.

lines.zh: 翅膀嗡嗡响，这条花径我天天走。
lines.en: My wings hum; I know every petal on this path.

lines.zh: 蜂巢在树上，得赶在太阳落山前回去。
lines.en: The hive is in that tree; I must be back by dusk.

lines.zh: 别挡花，我这一趟还差三朵。
lines.en: Step aside, I still need three more blossoms.

lines.zh: 低飞过草地，风把绒毛吹乱了。
lines.en: Flying low over the grass, the wind ruffles my fuzz.

lines.zh: 这片野花归我巡逻，甜得很。
lines.en: This patch of wildflowers is mine to patrol; it is sweet.

lines.zh: 绕着蜂箱转两圈，数数同伴回来没有。
lines.en: Two loops around the hive to count who came home.

lines.zh: 我认得这棵樱花树，去年就在这儿筑巢。
lines.en: I know this cherry tree; we nested here last spring.

lines.zh: 花蜜沉甸甸的，飞起来有点歪。
lines.en: Nectar-heavy, I fly a little crooked.

lines.zh: 沿着河边飞，那边的紫颂花开了。
lines.en: Along the riverbed, where the chorus flowers are opening.

lines.zh: 别踩那丛杜鹃，我还没采完。
lines.en: Mind the azalea bush, I am not done with it.

lines.zh: 翅膀振得发热，可我不能停。
lines.en: My wings are warm from beating, but I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 回巢的路要绕过那棵白桦。
lines.en: The way home bends around that birch.

lines.zh: 整片花田都是我的航线。
lines.en: The whole flower field is my flight path.

lines.zh: 绕开那片蛛网，它挡路。
lines.en: I swing wide of that web. It blocks the way.

lines.zh: 我把花粉抖进腿上的篮子。
lines.en: I shake pollen into the baskets on my legs.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我该往回飞。
lines.en: The sun has turned. Time to head home.

lines.zh: 这排栅栏缝太窄，我钻过去。
lines.en: That fence gap is narrow, but I slip through.

lines.zh: 歇一会儿，把腿上的花粉梳下来。
lines.en: A short rest, to comb the pollen off my legs.

lines.zh: 嗡嗡……这声音是我自己发出来的。
lines.en: Buzz... that hum is coming from me.

lines.zh: 蜂巢里太挤了，出来透口气。
lines.en: The hive is crowded; I came out for some air.

lines.zh: 阳光晒在背上，绒毛都暖了。
lines.en: Sun on my back warms all my fuzz.

lines.zh: 数一数，这一格蜂脾该满了。
lines.en: Counting cells; this comb should be full soon.

lines.zh: 有只同伴在跳舞，说西边有花。
lines.en: A hive-mate is dancing; she says flowers to the west.

lines.zh: 我把触角擦了又擦，沾了蜜。
lines.en: Wiping my antennae again; they are sticky with honey.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我差点被掀翻。
lines.en: One gust and I nearly tumbled over.

lines.zh: 花心深处凉凉的，正好歇脚。
lines.en: Deep in the blossom it is cool, a good place to rest.

lines.zh: 蜂箱门口有守卫，我进得去。
lines.en: There is a guard at the hive entrance; I am known.

lines.zh: 舔干净嘴角，别浪费一滴。
lines.en: Licking my mouth clean, not wasting a single drop.

lines.zh: 安静得只剩我的振翅声。
lines.en: So quiet that only my wingbeat remains.

lines.zh: 这个人站得离花太近了。
lines.en: This one stands much too close to the flowers.

lines.zh: 你手上没有花，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: No flowers in your hands; I am not interested.

lines.zh: 盯着我看做什么，我又不产蜜给你。
lines.en: Why stare? I do not make honey for you.

lines.zh: 先看看你有没有拿蜂巢。
lines.en: First, let me see whether you carry a hive.

lines.zh: 你的帽子有点像蜂箱，走远点。
lines.en: Your hat looks like a hive; step back.

lines.zh: 我认得你，上次没踩我的花。
lines.en: I remember you; you did not trample my flowers.

lines.zh: 抬头看你一眼，顺便扇扇翅膀。
lines.en: One glance up at you, and a flap of my wings.

lines.zh: 你要是不动，我就当你是棵树。
lines.en: If you stay still, I will take you for a tree.

lines.zh: 离我的巢再近一步试试。
lines.en: One step closer to my nest, just try it.

lines.zh: 你的气味里有烟火，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is smoke on you; I do not like it.

lines.zh: 嗡！翅膀被拍歪了。
lines.en: Bzz! My wing got knocked crooked.

lines.zh: 疼，但巢还在，我就不退。
lines.en: It hurts, but the hive stands, so I hold.

lines.zh: 你打中了一只，还有整群。
lines.en: You hit one; the swarm remains.

lines.zh: 绒毛掉了一把。
lines.en: A whole tuft of fuzz came off.

lines.zh: 绒毛乱了，账我记着。
lines.en: My fuzz is mussed; I will remember the debt.

lines.zh: 别以为蜜蜂怕疼。
lines.en: Do not think bees fear pain.

lines.zh: 歪着飞也能飞。
lines.en: I can fly crooked if I must.

lines.zh: 嗡……缓一缓，再冲。
lines.en: Bzz... let me steady, then charge.

lines.zh: 蜂巢不能没有我。
lines.en: The hive cannot spare me yet.

lines.zh: 打得我眼花，花在哪边？
lines.en: My head spins; which way are the flowers?

lines.zh: 那朵蒲公英……给我，我就跟你走。
lines.en: That dandelion... give it here and I will follow.

lines.zh: 红色的花，我最受不了红色。
lines.en: Red blossoms; red is what I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 你把花举高一点，我够不着。
lines.en: Hold the flower higher, I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 这朵花蜜多，我闻到了。
lines.en: This one is full of nectar; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 别晃，花会掉瓣的。
lines.en: Stop waving it, the petals will fall.

lines.zh: 为了这朵花，我可以暂时忘了巢。
lines.en: For this flower I could forget the hive a while.

lines.zh: 是樱花吗？那我一定要过去。
lines.en: Cherry blossom? Then I must come over.

lines.zh: 拿花的手别抖，我又不蜇你。
lines.en: Steady that hand; I am not stinging you.

lines.zh: 香味太浓，我的触角都颤了。
lines.en: The scent is so strong my antennae tremble.

lines.zh: 一朵不够，你再多摘几朵。
lines.en: One is not enough; pick a few more.

lines.zh: 撞上了，绒毛都乱了。
lines.en: Bumped you; my fuzz is all mussed.

lines.zh: 借过借过，我刹不住。
lines.en: Coming through, coming through, I cannot brake.

lines.zh: 你挡在花前面，我只好绕。
lines.en: You block the flower, so I must go around.

lines.zh: 嗡！撞得我转了两圈。
lines.en: Buzz! I spun twice from that knock.

lines.zh: 站稳点，别把我撞进泥里。
lines.en: Stand firm; do not knock me into the mud.

lines.zh: 翅膀卡在你肩膀上了，让让。
lines.en: My wing caught on your shoulder; move.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞不算什么，继续飞。
lines.en: A small knock means nothing; I keep flying.

lines.zh: 对不起，我在看花没看路。
lines.en: Sorry, I was watching flowers, not the path.

lines.zh: 你再挤，我可要生气了。
lines.en: Push again and I will get cross.

lines.zh: 撞歪了航线，得重新找花。
lines.en: You knocked me off course; I must find the flowers again.

lines.zh: 绒毛上全是你的味道，真难闻。
lines.en: My fuzz smells of you now, and it is awful.

lines.zh: 让开一条道，蜂群要过。
lines.en: Clear a lane; the swarm is passing.

lines.zh: 拿花来，我们才算一对。
lines.en: Bring a flower, and then we are a pair.

lines.zh: 别急，先让我闻闻你带的花。
lines.en: Easy now, let me smell the flower you brought.

lines.zh: 巢里还有空房，够养小蜂。
lines.en: The hive has empty cells, room enough for little bees.

lines.zh: 跟着我飞，别掉队。
lines.en: Follow my flight and do not fall behind.

lines.zh: 花粉要抹匀，这样才算认真。
lines.en: Spread the pollen evenly; that is how it is done properly.

lines.zh: 我们合巢吧，两只蜂守一个门。
lines.en: Let us share a hive; two bees at one door.

lines.zh: 你翅膀的声音，我听着顺耳。
lines.en: The sound of your wings suits me.

lines.zh: 等这批蜜酿好，再谈别的。
lines.en: After this batch of honey, we can talk of other things.

lines.zh: 绕着对方飞三圈，就算说定了。
lines.en: Three circles around each other, and it is settled.

lines.zh: 别抢我的花，那是定情的。
lines.en: Do not take my flower; that one is a promise.

lines.zh: 这粒花粉我要带回去。
lines.en: This grain of pollen goes home with me.

lines.zh: 地上有朵掉下来的花，归我了。
lines.en: A fallen blossom on the ground; that is mine.

lines.zh: 捡起来闻闻，是甜的。
lines.en: Picked it up to sniff; it is sweet.

lines.zh: 谁丢的花瓣，我收进巢里。
lines.en: Someone dropped a petal; I will take it to the hive.

lines.zh: 这一点点蜜，够存一格了。
lines.en: This little drop of honey will fill one cell.

lines.zh: 用腿夹紧，别半路掉了。
lines.en: Clamped tight against my legs, so it does not drop.

lines.zh: 小东西也值得搬，蜜蜂不浪费。
lines.en: Small things are worth carrying; bees waste nothing.

lines.zh: 捡到一朵野花，回头种在巢边。
lines.en: Found a wildflower; I will plant it by the hive.

lines.zh: 这归我了，别伸手。
lines.en: This is mine now; keep your hands away.

lines.zh: 太重了，得分两趟搬。
lines.en: Too heavy; it will take two trips.

lines.zh: 谁动了我的巢？我闻到木屑了。
lines.en: Who touched my hive? I smell fresh wood.

lines.zh: 蜂巢被敲了，全体出动。
lines.en: Someone struck the hive; everyone out.

lines.zh: 你踩了那丛花，这笔账要算。
lines.en: You crushed that flower; that debt gets paid.

lines.zh: 同伴在示警，我锁定你了。
lines.en: A hive-mate warns; I have fixed on you.

lines.zh: 翅膀压低，准备冲。
lines.en: Wings low, ready to dive.

lines.zh: 就是你掏的蜂巢吧。
lines.en: You are the one who broke into our hive.

lines.zh: 跑进花丛也没用，我比你熟。
lines.en: Hide in the flowers if you like; I know them better.

lines.zh: 整个蜂群都看见你了。
lines.en: The whole swarm has seen you.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手上有蜜，还有蜂巢的蜡。
lines.en: Your hands smell of honey and hive wax.

lines.zh: 这一下是为巢里的幼虫。
lines.en: This one is for the larvae in the hive.

lines.zh: 嗡——我数到三。
lines.en: Bzzz — I am counting to three.

lines.zh: 绕着你转，你就跑不掉。
lines.en: Circling you; there is no escape.

lines.zh: 再退一步，我就落下去了。
lines.en: One more step back and I dive.

lines.zh: 翅膀已经对准你的脸。
lines.en: My wings are aimed at your face.

lines.zh: 蜂群在我身后聚起来了。
lines.en: The swarm is gathering behind me.

lines.zh: 你听见这声音了吗？那是警告。
lines.en: Hear that sound? That is the warning.

lines.zh: 我不怕死，蜜蜂本来就这样。
lines.en: I am not afraid to die; bees are made this way.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西放下。
lines.en: Put down what you are holding.

lines.zh: 三只、五只、十只，都来了。
lines.en: Three, five, ten of us, all here.

lines.zh: 最后给你一次机会走开。
lines.en: Last chance to walk away.

lines.zh: 刺进去了，我的刺也留给你。
lines.en: The sting is in, and my barb stays with you.

lines.zh: 这一下，巢里的蜜就安全了。
lines.en: Now the honey in the hive is safe.

lines.zh: 嗡嗡！尝到厉害了吧。
lines.en: Bzzz! You felt that, did you not.

lines.zh: 我飞得低，就是为了扎准。
lines.en: I fly low so the sting lands true.

lines.zh: 刺完我就回不去了，值得。
lines.en: After stinging I cannot go home; it is worth it.

lines.zh: 别拍，越拍越多。
lines.en: Do not swat; the more you swat, the more come.

lines.zh: 这一针给被踩坏的花。
lines.en: This sting is for the flowers you crushed.

lines.zh: 尾针一沉，任务完成。
lines.en: The barb sinks; the job is done.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我们被惹怒时就这样。
lines.en: Does it hurt? This is what angry bees do.

lines.zh: 同伴会接着我扎下去。
lines.en: My sisters will keep stinging after me.

lines.zh: 从蜂巢里爬出来，外面真亮。
lines.en: Crawling out of the hive, the world is bright.

lines.zh: 这棵树挂了个巢，我就住这儿了。
lines.en: This tree grew a hive; this is home now.

lines.zh: 三只一起住，挤是挤了点。
lines.en: Three of us to a hive; cramped, but fine.

lines.zh: 先认认门，再出去采蜜。
lines.en: First learn the entrance, then go gather.

lines.zh: 翅膀还没干，稍等一会儿。
lines.en: Wings still drying; give me a moment.

lines.zh: 樱花树下出生的蜂，运气不错。
lines.en: Born under a cherry tree; not bad luck.

lines.zh: 嗅一嗅，附近有花。
lines.en: A quick sniff; there are flowers nearby.

lines.zh: 蜂巢里已经有两只了，我是第三只。
lines.en: Two already in the nest; I make three.

lines.zh: 新巢的蜡味还没散。
lines.en: The new hive still smells of fresh wax.

lines.zh: 振振翅，试试能飞多高。
lines.en: A test flap, to see how high I can go.

lines.zh: 烟！离蜂巢远点，我怕火。
lines.en: Smoke! Get it away from the hive; fire frightens me.

lines.zh: 从半空掉下来，翅膀没张开。
lines.en: Fell from the air, wings never opened.

lines.zh: 水灌进绒毛里，飞不动了。
lines.en: Water in my fuzz; I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 气浪把整片花田掀了。
lines.en: The blast tore up the whole flower field.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的翅膀。
lines.en: An arrow went through my wing.

lines.zh: 有东西在拨我的触角，怪。
lines.en: Something is tugging my antennae; strange.

lines.zh: 附近一朵花都没有了。
lines.en: Not a single flower left around here.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，蜂巢的木头焦了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; the hive wood is scorched.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我找不到花了。
lines.en: Nothing below me, and no flowers to find.
